prompt: Classify each quantity as scalar or vector: distance, displacement, speed and velocity.

mark_scheme.criterion: Classifies distance and speed as scalars.
Classifies displacement and velocity as vectors.

hints: A scalar needs magnitude only. A vector needs magnitude and direction.
Ask whether a value and unit completely describe each quantity without stating a direction.
solution: Scalars: distance and speed. Vectors: displacement and velocity.
teacher_walkthrough: Distance and speed are fully stated by magnitude and unit, so they are scalars.
Displacement describes a change in position in a specified direction, so it is a vector.
Velocity is based on displacement and also requires direction, so it is a vector.
